WebChartHistogramSeries

Source: R/types-histogram.R
WebChartHistogramSeries.Rd

The histogram's series. Bins are computed in the browser, which is why there is no y to map and why set_tooltip() cannot key onto one.

Value

An object of class WebChartHistogramSeries.

Examples

WebChartHistogramSeries(
  type = "histogramSeries",
  id = "series0",
  x = "body_mass",
  binCount = 15,
  dataTransformationType = WebChartDataTransformations("logarithmic")
)

#>  @ id                      : chr "series0"
